items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I know that boy, Robert Taylor.

ctx.x: You never heard him do that, huh? Well, I've heard talked about it.
I know that boy, Robert Taylor. He got that... Well, he kicked that woman. He got power. He could preach on the home.
How would he do that? What's that like? What's that like?
